understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with a '+' at the same time; if there are multiple '+' tiles, all of them must be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and finish the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were issued by CLICKing a target position in the grid. A CLICK would attempt to move the currently selected piece toward/into the clicked tile according to the game’s movement rules; if the path was blocked by a wall/obstacle, another piece, or an invalid move, the piece would not move and the step was still consumed. Pieces could be selected (implicitly by clicking/interaction with a piece or its tile), and only the selected piece responded to movement clicks. Movement could involve sliding/stepping until blocked depending on the level rules; pushing only worked when the adjacent tile arrangement allowed it, otherwise the move failed. Walls/obstacles were impassable, and the per-level step budget was finite so failed clicks reduced remaining steps.
